person.description: Look up a person by email address, returns demographic, employment, social, and geographic data

company.description: Look up a company by domain, returns firmographic, technographic, and financial data

combined.description: Combined person and company lookup in a single request using email, returns both person and company data

identify.description: Segment's Clearbit Enrichment integration listens for identify events, extracts the email from traits, calls the Clearbit Combined Enrichment API, and writes enriched person and company data back as traits on the user profile. Clearbit enrichment data appears as nested traits prefixed with clearbit_company.* and clearbit_person.* in downstream destinations.

email_as_lookup_key.description: The email from the identify call's traits is used as the primary lookup key for the Clearbit Enrichment API. Both Segment and RudderStack extract traits.email to query the Combined Person/Company endpoint.

person_name.description: Person's full name from Clearbit enrichment response is mapped to clearbit_person_fullName trait.

person_given_name.description: Person's given (first) name from Clearbit enrichment.

person_family_name.description: Person's family (last) name from Clearbit enrichment.

person_employment_title.description: Person's job title from Clearbit employment data. Maps to trait for downstream use in lead scoring and routing.

person_employment_role.description: Person's functional role (e.g., 'engineering', 'marketing', 'sales'). Used for persona segmentation.

person_employment_seniority.description: Person's seniority level (e.g., 'executive', 'manager', 'director'). Used for lead prioritization.

person_location.description: Person's geographic location string (e.g., 'San Francisco, CA, US').

person_gender.description: Person's inferred gender. Note: Clearbit infers gender from name data.

person_bio.description: Person's biographical description, typically sourced from social profiles.

company_industry.description: Company's industry classification from Clearbit's category taxonomy.

company_estimated_annual_revenue.description: Company's estimated annual revenue range string (e.g., '$10M-$50M').

company_raised.description: Total funding raised by the company in USD (integer).

company_tags.description: Array of descriptive tags for the company (e.g., ['SaaS', 'B2B']).

enrichment_trait_naming.description: Both Segment and RudderStack use a flattened trait naming convention with clearbit_ prefix to namespace enrichment data. The exact trait key format may vary slightly between implementations.
enrichment_trait_naming.known_gap: Trait key naming convention (e.g., clearbit_company_name vs clearbit.company.name vs company.name) may differ between Segment and RudderStack implementations. Verify exact Transformer output.

enrichment_request_response.description: Clearbit Enrichment is unique among destinations because it enriches the event rather than simply forwarding it. Both platforms send a GET request to the Clearbit Combined API with the user's email, receive person + company data, and write it back as traits.

request_flow.step_3: Call Clearbit Combined Enrichment API: GET https://person-stream.clearbit.com/v2/combined/find?email=<email>
request_flow.step_4: Receive enrichment response with person and company objects
request_flow.step_5: Flatten enrichment response into trait key-value pairs with clearbit_ prefix
request_flow.step_6: Write enriched traits back to user profile
request_flow.step_7: Forward enriched identify event (with new traits) to downstream destinations

async_handling.description: Clearbit may return HTTP 202 Accepted if the person/company data is not immediately available. The streaming API (person-stream.clearbit.com) holds the connection open for up to 60 seconds to avoid 202 responses. Webhook-based async delivery is also supported.
async_handling.segment_approach: Uses streaming API by default; falls back to webhook for async cases
async_handling.rudderstack_approach: Uses Transformer service to handle Clearbit API calls; async handling via Transformer retry logic
async_handling.known_gap: Async enrichment handling (202 Accepted, webhook callbacks) may differ between Segment and RudderStack Transformer implementations

identify_parity.description: Identify calls trigger Clearbit enrichment via the Combined API. Both Segment and RudderStack extract traits.email, call the same Clearbit API endpoint, and write enriched data back as traits. The core enrichment flow is architecturally equivalent.
known_gaps: Trait naming convention: exact prefix and separator format may differ between Segment and RudderStack Transformer output (clearbit_company_name vs company.name)
Async handling: 202 Accepted response handling and retry behavior may differ
Enrichment data freshness: Clearbit caches data and de-duplicates API calls within billing periods; behavior may vary based on API key configuration
Error handling: Behavior on 404 (person not found), 422 (invalid email), and 429 (rate limit exceeded) may differ
RudderStack envelope fields (rudderId, originalTimestamp, sentAt, receivedAt) are not present in Segment events

enrichment_architecture_parity.description: Both platforms use the Clearbit Combined Enrichment API (person + company in one call). The key architectural difference is that Segment's Clearbit integration runs as a native server-side destination, while RudderStack delegates enrichment to the Transformer service (port 9090).
known_gaps: Segment uses a native Clearbit integration with direct API calls; RudderStack uses the Transformer service as a proxy
Streaming API vs webhook handling for async enrichment responses
Rate limit management and credit consumption tracking differences
Clearbit was acquired by HubSpot; integration may evolve toward Breeze Intelligence

notes: Clearbit is a shared cloud destination in the Enrichment category. Unlike most destinations that forward events to an external API, Clearbit is an enrichment destination that augments identify events with person and company data from the Clearbit Combined Enrichment API. The enrichment flow: (1) identify event received with traits.email, (2) Clearbit Combined API queried with email, (3) person data (name, employment, social, geo) and company data (firmographics, technographics, metrics) returned, (4) enriched data written back as traits with clearbit_ prefix, (5) enriched event forwarded to downstream destinations. Clearbit was acquired by HubSpot in 2023 and is being rebranded as Breeze Intelligence. The Person API endpoint is person.clearbit.com/v2/people/find, the Company API is company.clearbit.com/v2/companies/find, and the Combined API is person-stream.clearbit.com/v2/combined/find. Authentication uses HTTP Basic Auth (API key as username, empty password). Rate limit: 600 requests/minute. Key parity areas: (1) enrichment trait naming convention, (2) async 202 handling, (3) error handling for 404/422/429 responses, (4) enrichment data completeness and field mapping. Clearbit returns 100+ data attributes across person and company objects.
